reviewType: Current-source scoped native SPEC review, Chat entry/profile-origin draft + grouped Activity reading/targets. Not whole-app/full-catalog/signed-update/motion acceptance.

approvedReference.comparison: Viewed preserved Activity/conversation originals, and already-reviewed pinned source for labelled14dp search/contact fields,22sp task titles, fullwidth14dp blockactions,24dp conversational input. Actual identities/data/history intentionally differ.

productionBridge.qualification: Only visual-source/build delta is a nonvisual Activity group testTag. Earlier FFE Search/writing/wallet pixel reviews remain separately qualified, not repeated here.

observations: Inspected Chat entry at320100/130/200 light/dark, current profile-origin exact identity/draft on bothSDKs. Labelled14dp ordinary field,22sp taskheading, fullwidth14dp mainaction and24dp conversation input are present.

Actual native contact proofs show full public-key caption after real reveal and >=48px visible physical target for all14 checked observations; these are distinct from initially clipped list screenshots.

Grouped Activity preserves realactor identity,3likes/3people disclosure, All/Mentions selector hierarchy,2unread and actual read-history context. No actionable overlap/ink/shape defect found in sampled originals.

All24 return records across320/412100/130/200bothThemes/SDKs report genuine nonzero starting scroll (minimum48) and exact before/after row-top+axis equality. This is instrumented bounded observation, not physical gesture fluency.
All24 native avatar triples are >=48px, pairwise disjoint and each of72 rectangles matches the corresponding actual XML node exactly.
Raw packets confirm ChatEntry1test perSDK, Activity2tests perSDK PASS. Those focused results do not establish full-catalog acceptance.
limits: 39selected nativePNG/XML pairs of148 available originalPNG,2prototypePNG. Metadata checked more configurations than visually sampled.
All four packets contain0MP4. No motion/transition/physical fluency inference from stills.
PNG/XML/JSON records are sequential observations; matching bounds corroborates geometry, not atomicity.
At200% Chat reading viewport is short and initial row is clipped; separate actual-reveal/native-target observations establish the specific caption/target goal. No all-content-at-once claim.
Android17 realIME education panel can obscure or scroll form input; images are bounded captures of that systemUI state.
Selected Activity pictures show All selected and Mentions control available. Mentions-selected content/return is covered by a different fixture, not claimed from these packets.
Profile-origin Android10 draft capture still has Loadingmessages; no history-completion claim from that frame.
Pending whole-catalog gates, signed-update, remaining app surfaces and motion require separate evidence.
